author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Tetris® 99 58th MAXIMUS CUP event runs from 11pm PT on November 26 to 10:59pm PT on November 30. To participate, you’ll need to be a Nintendo Switch Online member* and play the Tetris 99 online mode during the event period. You’ll earn event points based on your placement in each match. Once you’ve accumulated a total of 100 event points, a new theme will unlock, featuring art, music and Tetrimino designs inspired by the Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy game for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! 
 
*Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/purchase-terms/

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Wave Race™ Blue Storm is coming to GameCube – Nintendo Classics!

Storm warning! Prepare to ride the waves!

Take to the water in this watercraft-racing game, released for the Nintendo GameCube™ system in 2001. Compete in contests of speed and technique—either racing against your rivals or going up against your own records. As you race across the waves, you can see the skies changes from calm and sunny to surging storms... Weather conditions can affect visibility, water levels, and the height of the waves over the course of a race, so you'll need to be prepared for whatever comes!
